needs_a_look.title: An SSH file that decides who can log in to this Mac, or how it connects to other machines, was added, changed or removed.
needs_a_look.meaning: This is normal when you just added a key, a server or a setting.
needs_a_look.advice: If you did not, look at the file now, before you next connect anywhere.

needs_a_look.title: A file your terminal runs every time it starts was added, changed or removed.
needs_a_look.meaning: This is normal when you or an installer just edited it; many tools add a line there.
needs_a_look.advice: If you did not, open the file and look at its last lines.

needs_a_look.title: A program set to start by itself on this Mac was added, changed or removed.
needs_a_look.meaning: This is normal right after you install, update or remove an app that works in the background.
needs_a_look.advice: If you did not just do that, look at the file named here and find out which app it belongs to.

needs_a_look.title: A machine could not be reached.
needs_a_look.meaning: This is normal if it is switched off or offline; while it cannot be reached, changes on it go unseen.
needs_a_look.advice: If it should be on, check that you can connect to it.

result.answers_note: Marking a finding expected or seen is the owner's answer: it hides the finding from him. An agent must not give it on the owner's behalf; it may show the owner the command to give it.
